scope: Local 0.6.3 source against v0.6.2, including the dev site, assets/Lab, UI histories/cases, exporters and current navigation.

findings.title: Bot lab Analysis retains a desktop-width summary grid on phones
findings.evidence: At 412px, the page scroll width is 780px in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, even with rows closed. At 320px/200% text, the measured overflow is 511px. The summary grid is 360px plus four 86px columns. A browser-only one-column override returns the page to 412px.
findings.fix: Make the Analysis summary respond at narrow widths; retain local proof-board scrolling. Add Analysis closed/open and enlarged-text reflow coverage.

findings.title: Capture regions reuse accessible names across comparisons
findings.evidence: Eight review records trigger axe landmark-unique at all three inspected sizes (24 rule reports). Mobile records repeats Before/After capture region names three times. A fresh-page scan confirms the same result without changing image loading. This is an axe best-practice finding, not 24 distinct WCAG violations.
findings.fix: Include comparison context in capture region names or associate unique headings/captions; check normal and native modes across complete cases.

findings.title: The in-flight private-write cloud check still targets the old Home label
findings.evidence: D02 Chromium times out waiting for the exact Developer link after the label became Dev site. The pending-write assertion is never reached. Cleanup masks the primary locator failure with a closed-context unroute error. D01 passes in all three engines.
findings.fix: Update the selector and preserve the original failure during cleanup; rerun D02 across all three engines.

findings.title: Single-case export output can escape the dedicated root through a symlink
findings.evidence: An owned probe under the ignored review-export root symlinked to an owned temporary directory. Export succeeded and created index.html outside the dedicated root. The probe was removed. No source or existing output was overwritten. The full-site exporter has stronger real-path checks.
findings.fix: Use physical-path containment and reject symlinked parents before creating output; retain exclusive creation and ignored-output checks.

findings.title: The older visual-audit helper decodes lazy images before they load
findings.evidence: The helper fails in Firefox with Invalid image request before writing its final audit receipt. A focused probe reproduces the error with unloaded lazy captures; making them eager then decoding passes, with no failed image requests.
findings.fix: Wait for selected image identity/loading or explicitly request audit images before decode, and preserve partial results on failure.
